what_to_detect: A modal resolution in which one mode is chosen several times and so carried out several times in sequence; the repeated mode resolutions share a link_id and the same mode key.
near_miss: A modal resolution in which every chosen mode is distinct, each carried out once.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate for a modal spell whose modes carry additional costs, its cost_after_adjustment holding the base cost plus the cost of every mode chosen.
near_miss: A candidate for such a spell whose adjusted cost leaves out the cost of a mode not chosen.

what_to_detect: A static whose condition counts its controller's devotion to a colour applies or not according to the devotion counted from the mana symbols of the mana costs of the permanents that player controls.
near_miss: The same static with the count on the other side of its threshold, its conditional contribution the other way.
record_fields: gen-3 card mana_cost of each entity
the static's script Count$Devotion and SVarCompare$

what_to_detect: A static whose condition counts devotion applies according to the devotion counted over mana costs plus effects that modify devotion, and the static's own change to its object's characteristics does not change the count.
near_miss: The same static with no devotion modifier on the battlefield, the count read from mana costs alone.
record_fields: gen-3 card mana_cost of each entity
the statics on the battlefield and their script Count$Devotion

what_to_detect: A characteristic or amount that counts its controller's party equals the number of the four party types (Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard) among that player's creatures, at most four, a second creature of one type adding nothing.
near_miss: A party count to which a creature of a type already counted adds nothing.
record_fields: payload contributions pt with a set (=) value

what_to_detect: A party count in which a creature with several party types fills whichever slot gives the largest party.
near_miss: A party count in which every creature has one party type.
record_fields: payload contributions pt with a set (=) value

what_to_detect: An effect that names its object by a quality ("the creature", "this artifact") acts on that object although the object no longer has the quality when the effect happens.
near_miss: The same effect acting on an object that still has the quality.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose target selector requires a permanent that was activated this turn has such a permanent among its legal targets.
near_miss: A candidate with that selector whose possible targets include no permanent activated this turn.
record_fields: gen-3 card history bit: activated a loyalty ability

what_to_detect: A trigger conditioned on its player having descended this turn is evaluated and fires when a permanent card was put into that player's graveyard this turn.
near_miss: The same trigger is evaluated and does not fire because no permanent card (only nonpermanent cards or tokens) went to that player's graveyard.

what_to_detect: An amount that counts the outlaws a player controls counts only outlaw permanents: an outlaw spell on the stack adds nothing.
near_miss: The same amount with an outlaw permanent on the battlefield, which counts.
record_fields: state.entities[].zone and types (outlaw subtypes on the stack and battlefield)
the acting line's script SVar Count$Valid Permanent.Outlaw

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose target selector requires a worthy creature (legendary, not a Villain, red or white) has such a creature among its legal targets.
near_miss: A candidate with that selector whose possible targets include no worthy creature.
